contract.native: Additive protocolVersion 2: getCapabilities, testCutter, confirmCutter, printBatch. Legacy printBase64 retained.
contract.sequence: One printBatch call / one socket: unchanged customer raster + ESC d 4 / GS V 65 16 full cut + preparation raster + ESC d 4 / GS V 65 16 full cut.
contract.transport: 64-row raster bands, writes <=512 bytes, 60ms chunk/120ms band/500ms footer drain; validates ALL copies before sending.
contract.acknowledgement: sent_unconfirmed never implies physical completion. Full-cut capability requires device-specific operator test confirmation.
contract.recovery: Persist before native send. Durable native attempt ledger rejects replay after restart. Manual missing-copy selection only; no automatic retransmit after unknown transport.
contract.audit: One batch UUID with separate customer/preparation idempotency keys; receipt row lock serializes concurrent duplicates. Legacy merchant untouched.
contract.navigation: Recent bills removed from Android sales; /takeaway/store/receipts in submenu only; individual or explicit-warning two-copy reprint.
contract.authorization: Frontend local jobs company/brand/branch/user scoped; receipt history and confirmation server company/brand/branch scoped. Printing requires sale.create; backend read allows sale.view.
contract.preparation: Queue, order number, Bangkok time, quantities, Thai names and line/order notes only. Canonical order-note projection handles old receipt snapshots. No financial fields.
contract.unrelated_scope: No VAT calculation, order acceptance/handoff UX, payment provider, inventory behavior or Production changes.
